column1: # Feature anchors in GQL.g4 @ 16ea71b (provisional, OQ-005). Own data (MIT, lpg project).
# One line per feature code of ISO_IEC_39075(en)-features.xml:
# Anchor forms (checked against GQL.g4 by feature_map.py):
#   rule/N      top-level alternative N (1-based) of the rule
#   rule:NAME   one element (token or rule reference) of the rule; partial, unless the token
#               alone forms an alternative (ANTLR reports one alternative for such token sets)
#   ...+CODE    the anchor needs CODE as well (conjunction)
#   -           no parser rule: the feature is semantic, lexical or a refinement of another code
# Two codes on the same anchor in different lines are alternatives (either suffices).
# Evidence: "insert" = the insert's description names the construct; "gc:<id>" = gql-compat @ 9de1991
# case corpus/suite/*.yaml whose `features` list the code; "neo4j" = Neo4j Cypher Manual
